items.title: Professional Pensions people moves for the week ending 6 November 2026
items.summary: Professional Pensions reports on industry appointments including Standard Life, TPT Retirement Solutions, Isio, and a leadership change at the LGPS Scheme Advisory Board.

items.title: Blackstone and Aon establish Cortina reinsurance syndicate at Lloyd's
items.summary: Blackstone Inc. and Aon Plc have formed a new Lloyd's of London syndicate named Cortina to back reinsurance contracts, with underwriting managed by QBE.

items.title: Aon and Blackstone launch Lloyd's syndicate Cortina with QBE as managing agent
items.summary: Aon and Blackstone funds have launched Cortina syndicate 1956 at Lloyd's, with QBE serving as managing agent to provide multi-year reinsurance capacity.

items.title: Amiga Specialty expands commercial professional indemnity capacity
items.summary: MGA Amiga Specialty has secured additional underwriting capacity for its commercial professional indemnity proposition.

items.title: XPS Group appointed as PMI development partner
items.summary: XPS Group has partnered with the Pensions Management Institute to support professional standards and learner progress.

items.title: Professional Pensions and Gravis to host infrastructure investment webinar
items.summary: Professional Pensions and Gravis Capital Management are hosting an online discussion on 11 November examining pension scheme investment in UK infrastructure.
